 Bandhan Bank reported a net profit of ₹622 crore in Q2 FY27, with gross NPAs at 3.11%, interest earned at ₹5,754 crore and provisions at ₹718 crore.
 Bandhan Bank reported a net profit of ₹622 crore for the September quarter, with gross non-performing assets at 3.11% and provisions at ₹718 crore.
 Reuters 1 min read Last Updated : Oct 28 2026 | 4:31 PM IST Listen to This Article
 Bandhan Bank Ltd reported a net profit of ₹622 crore for the September quarter (Q2 FY27).   The bank's gross non-performing assets (NPA) stood at 3.11%, while interest earned during the quarter was ₹5,754 crore.   Provisions and contingencies stood at ₹718 crore during the quarter.   More From This Section
